sn15.4:1.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.4:1.4: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, katamannu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññaṃ pītaṃ, yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti?
sn15.4:1.5: “yathā kho mayaṃ bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāma, etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññaṃ pītaṃ, natveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udaka”nti.
sn15.4:2.1: sādhu sādhu bhikkhave, sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave, evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha.
sn15.4:2.2: etadeva bhikkhave, bahutaraṃ yaṃ vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ mātuthaññaṃ pītaṃ, natveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
